provenance.cohort_description: Cohort of 64 lung cancer patients treated with immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICI) therapy, categorized into Responders (R=34) vs Non-Responders (NR=30) at Sir Ganga Ram Hospital (SGRH).

entities.name: Metabolomics 5-Plex
entities.characteristics: Mass spectrometry intensity, right-skewed, severe run-order signal drift

entities.name: Immuno-Oncology 92-Plex Proteomics
entities.nature: Normalized Protein Expression (NPX), log2 scale, zero missing values

data_quality_issues.title: PFS exceeds OS in 4 patients
data_quality_issues.description: Biologically and clinically, PFS <= OS by definition. 4 patients have PFS strictly greater than OS.
data_quality_issues.impact: Distorts survival curves and Cox proportional hazards regression if uncorrected.
data_quality_issues.recommendation: Cross-reference medical charts to verify date of progression vs date of death/last follow-up.
data_quality_issues.resolution_status: MITIGATED: Added pfs_os_inversion_flag and pfs_days_harmonized capped at OS

data_quality_issues.title: Run-order instrument drift perfectly confounded with outcome-sorted cohort
data_quality_issues.description: Spreadsheet is sorted largely by outcome (Samples 1-20 are NR; Samples 43-64 are R). Metabolomics and proteomics exhibit profound monotonic run-order drift (e.g. Thio-Urea Spearman r = -0.85 within R, r = -0.76 within NR; glutathione r = +0.76 within R, r = +0.70 within NR).
data_quality_issues.impact: High risk of false-positive biomarker discovery and naive ML models learning run sequence rather than biological etiology.
data_quality_issues.recommendation: Apply run-order detrending / LOESS / batch-correction methods; require random shuffling in CV; do not allow sample ID or row index into any model.
data_quality_issues.resolution_status: MITIGATED: Computed run-order polynomial detrended residuals for drifting markers

data_quality_issues.title: Diet survey contradiction: 31 patients recorded as both Veg and Non-veg
data_quality_issues.description: 31 patients have Veg. == 1 AND non-veg. == 1. In addition, Sample 40 has non-veg recorded as string '1`' (backtick typo).
data_quality_issues.impact: Cannot treat Veg and Non-veg as mutually exclusive binary variables.
data_quality_issues.recommendation: Recode non-veg '1`' to 1; collapse diet into a unified categorical feature: Vegetarian (Veg=1, NonVeg=0, n=28), Non-Vegetarian (NonVeg=1, n=36), or verify survey wording.
data_quality_issues.resolution_status: RESOLVED: Sample 40 typo fixed, consolidated into Vegetarian vs Non-Vegetarian

data_quality_issues.title: Discrepancy between recorded BMI and weight/(height/100)^2
data_quality_issues.description: 8 patients have |BMI_rec - BMI_calc| > 1.0 kg/m2. Pt 39 has Height 180cm, Weight 70kg, calc BMI = 21.60 kg/m2, but recorded BMI = 29 (+7.40 error).
data_quality_issues.impact: Misclassifies patient weight status (normal weight vs overweight/obese).
data_quality_issues.recommendation: Recompute BMI as a standardized float feature: weight / (height/100)^2.
data_quality_issues.resolution_status: RESOLVED: Recomputed bmi_calculated as exact weight/(height/100)^2, corrected Patient 39 error

data_quality_issues.title: Whitespace in sex column creating 3 distinct categories
data_quality_issues.description: Sample 10 has sex recorded as 'F ' with a trailing whitespace, leading to categories ['M' (42), 'F' (21), 'F ' (1)].
data_quality_issues.impact: Unstripped string splits female patients into two separate dummy variables.
data_quality_issues.recommendation: Apply str.strip() across all string columns.
data_quality_issues.resolution_status: RESOLVED: Sample 10 whitespace stripped to M/F

data_quality_issues.title: 22 columns contain trailing whitespace in header names
data_quality_issues.description: Headers such as 'sample ', 'Hypertension ', 'SMOKING ', 'CANCER/TYPE ', 'TOTAL LEUCOCYTES COUNT .1', etc.
data_quality_issues.impact: Causes silent KeyError bugs and fragile script referencing.
data_quality_issues.recommendation: Strip and standardize column names into snake_case or clean alphanumeric names.
data_quality_issues.resolution_status: RESOLVED: Standardized all 146 headers into clean snake_case identifiers

data_quality_issues.title: Histology classification non-mutually exclusive and incomplete
data_quality_issues.description: Across 64 patients, 49 have exactly 1 histology flag, 8 have 2 flags (e.g. Adeno + Squamous), and 7 have 0 flags. CANCER/TYPE is binary 0 (39) vs 1 (25) but not documented.
data_quality_issues.impact: Ambiguous tumor subtyping in multivariate regression.
data_quality_issues.recommendation: Clarify meaning of CANCER/TYPE and establish consensus histology label per patient.
data_quality_issues.resolution_status: RESOLVED: Consolidated into histology_consensus single-label subtype

data_quality_issues.title: Stage III patient flagged with Metastasis = 1
data_quality_issues.description: Sample 22 is recorded as DISEASE STAGE III but Metastasis == 1. In AJCC staging, distant metastasis defines Stage IV.
data_quality_issues.recommendation: Verify whether metastasis refers to nodal/locoregional vs distant metastasis for Patient 22.

data_quality_issues.title: Differential leukocyte percentage sums deviate substantially from 100%
data_quality_issues.description: Sum of Neutrophils + Lymphocytes + Monocytes + Eosinophils ranges from 61.2% to 129.0% at baseline, and 79.9% to 159.6% post-therapy. Basophils are omitted.
data_quality_issues.impact: Inflated differential percentages distort relative hematologic interpretations.
data_quality_issues.recommendation: Use absolute leukocyte counts where possible, or normalize differentials to 100%.

data_quality_issues.title: Extreme risk of overfitting in p >> n regime (p=144, n=64)
data_quality_issues.description: Ratio of features to samples is 2.25:1. Standard classification models will rapidly overfit without strict regularization.
data_quality_issues.impact: Inflated cross-validation scores, lack of generalizability.
data_quality_issues.recommendation: Use nested cross-validation, ElasticNet / Lasso penalty, feature screening based on domain knowledge, and PCA/UMAP.
